name: revxl-marketplace
description: REVXL's curated catalog of Claude superengines — opinionated, multi-skill plugins built for real coaching businesses. One install, per-plugin picker, auto-updates.

plugins.name: course-crawler
plugins.description: Capture any online content as a clean local archive for knowledge bases. Single pages, full multi-lesson courses (Kajabi/Teachable/Thinkific/Skool classrooms/custom), and YouTube playlists. Detects the agentic browser you have, handles login (assisted or manual cookie paste), and outputs clean Markdown + categorized reference links + downloaded assets + slide frames + transcripts. Local GPU Whisper by default (Groq/OpenAI fallback). Works on Mac and Windows.

plugins.name: workspace-superengine
plugins.description: Stops Claude from forgetting what you were working on. Sets up your workspace so every session picks up where the last one left off, follows your rules, and explains itself in plain language. Add modules for coding, client work, or content as needed. Works in Claude Desktop and Claude Code.

plugins.name: ghl-coach-superengine
plugins.description: GoHighLevel done-with-you toolkit for health/wellness/fitness coaches. 8 skills + 2 agents that build and maintain a persistent 13-file per-coach workspace, refresh it from GHL on every session, surface what needs attention, and execute multi-step work via MCP. Requires the GoHighLevel-MCP (mastanley13) and Filesystem MCP.

plugins.name: revxl-os-superengine
plugins.description: Autonomous coaching ops superengine for Claude Code. Three agents (morning brief, task surfacing, DM triage) running on schedules and event triggers, delivered through Telegram. Pairs with revxl-webhook-channel for webhook-driven automation. The OpenClaw alternative built on native Claude Code Channels.

plugins.name: offer-architect
plugins.description: Build market-validated, Hormozi-structured coaching offers — start to finish. 10 skills + 1 audit agent take a coach from intake → deep market research → value stack → pricing matrix → finalized offer → a 3–5 page Offer Blueprint (the coach's source of truth) + a Projected Success Score report (0–100 launch-readiness with plain-English priority fixes). Two-layer scoring: preventive exit-checks at every step + capstone audit. Hard rule on no-inventing-deliverables via provenance tags.
